jasper.bestFor: Teams and creators that want a dedicated AI writing assistant; Creator and Teams plans qualify for 25% recurring commissions
keyFeatures: Plan tiers: Creator, Teams, Business (Pro priced from $59/mo annual, $69/mo monthly)
pros: 25% recurring commission on Creator and Teams plans (paid per billing period)
cons: Business plans are excluded from the affiliate program
Commission window not stated in the official affiliate agreement (commonly cited 45-day cookie is unverified)
jasper.verdict: Jasper is a dedicated AI writing assistant from $59/mo (annual billing; $69 monthly). Its affiliate program pays 25% recurring on Creator and Teams plans, with Business excluded.

writesonic.bestFor: Content teams that want a broad plan range (Swipe Starter to Growth) and a defined 12-month recurring commission window
keyFeatures: AI writing tool for content generation
Plan tiers: Swipe Starter ($79/mo), Basic ($199/mo), Growth ($399/mo) - annual billing
pros: 60-day cookie gives a long attribution window
writesonic.verdict: Writesonic is an AI writing tool from $79/mo (annual billing). Its affiliate program pays 20% recurring for 12 months with a 60-day cookie.

scalenut.bestFor: SEO-focused content teams that want a 30-50% lifetime recurring commission
keyFeatures: Limited-time starter pricing from $24/mo noted on the pricing page
pros: 30-50% recurring commission for life - the longest window in this dataset
cons: Commission rate is stated as a 30-50% range on the official page
scalenut.verdict: Scalenut is an AI SEO content tool from $59/mo (Starter; limited offer from $24/mo). Its affiliate program pays 30-50% recurring commissions for life.

surfer.bestFor: SEO professionals who need on-page content optimization; affiliates get tiered one-time CPA commissions
keyFeatures: Plan tiers: Standard ($99/mo), Pro ($182/mo), Peace of Mind ($299/mo) - yearly billing
pros: Tiered one-time CPA: 75% of monthly plan fee at Tier 1, up to 125% at Tier 3
Yearly-plan commissions: 15% at Tier 1, up to 25% at Tier 3
cons: Commissions are one-time CPA, not recurring
Commission rate depends on affiliate tier
surfer.verdict: Surfer is an SEO content optimization tool from $99/mo (yearly billing). Its affiliate program pays tiered one-time CPA commissions (75% of a monthly plan at Tier 1 up to 125% at Tier 3), not recurring percentages.

brand24.bestFor: Brands and agencies that need social media monitoring; Individual plan from $199/mo on annual billing
keyFeatures: Plan tiers: Individual ($249/mo, $199/mo annual), Team ($349/mo), Pro ($499/mo)
brand24.verdict: Brand24 is a social media monitoring tool from $199/mo (annual billing; $249 monthly). Its affiliate program pays up to 30% recurring commissions.

krispcall.bestFor: Small businesses that need an AI phone system (from $12/mo)
keyFeatures: AI phone system for small business
krispcall.verdict: KrispCall is an AI phone system from $12/mo. Its affiliate program pays 30% recurring commissions for life.

pictory.bestFor: Creators who want AI video generation from scripts; Starter from $25/mo on annual billing
pictory.verdict: Pictory is an AI video generation tool from $25/mo (annual billing; $29 monthly). Its affiliate program pays recurring commissions up to 50%.

meetgeek.bestFor: Teams that want AI meeting notes and recordings; 30% recurring commission
meetgeek.verdict: MeetGeek is an AI meeting recorder and note-taker. Its affiliate program pays 30% recurring commissions. Pricing was not verified at publish time.
